cc:Work.dc:title: Original static-room runtime comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Original matched static-room baseline, 400,000 emissions / two simulated seconds, Ryzen 9 9950X3D + RTX 5090. Warp uses opt-in caller-owned history, headless stepping and USD writeback off. Native physics runs in both loops. Different scan directions and runtime boundaries; not identical-ray microbenchmarks or full-robot capacity.
